This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Gantry officer/Legends|gantry officer]]''' was stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[Docking Control Room 327]], together with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pol Treidum/Legends|Pol Treidum]].

==Biography==
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the officer and Treidum were on duty when a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel and docked in [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]]. A [[Scanning crew BT-445/Legends|scanning crew]] was brought in to inspect the freighter, and two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[TK-421/Legends|TK-421]] and [[TK-422]], were assigned to stand guard. As the officer worked at his station, Treidum noticed the troopers were not at their posts and radioed TK-421 to no avail, before looking out the room's viewport and seeing a trooper, who was actually [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in disguise, walk out of the ship and indicate that he had a bad transmitter. Treidum acknowledged and gave orders to the gantry officer to take over as he headed for the door. However, upon opening it, Treidum was hit in the face and knocked out by a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The officer quickly stood up and reached for his gun, but was shot by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had also disguised himself in stormtrooper armor.<ref name="ANH" />

The officer's corpse was later noticed by Death Star librarian [[Atour Riten]] as he viewed the room through a security camera.<ref name="DSn">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The gantry officer appears briefly in the [[1977]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]]'', portrayed by stuntman [[Malcolm Weaver]].<ref name="WeaverAutograph">
